It holds your ChatGPT OAuth tokens — treat it like"},{"id":"p23s3","text":" an API key.
- The harness process and its tool subprocesses run as your user; like the upstream cre"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"dentials document, this file is not hidden from tools the model can drive. Do not point the model's "},{"id":"p23s5","text":"workspace at your Harness home.
- Only `https` URLs issued by the login flow are ever handed to the "},{"id":"p23s6","text":"browser opener. A missing or failing OS opener is reported without terminating the harness; the CLI "},{"id":"p23s7","text":"still prints the URL for manual use.
- The login flow is pi-ai's provider-owned implementation (auth"},{"id":"p23s8","text":"orization-code + device-code against `chatgpt.com`); this plugin answers its interaction prompts and"},{"id":"p23s9","text":"vice-code against `chatgpt.com`); this plugin answers its interaction prompts and stores the result."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- `src/store.ts` — `FileCredentialStore`, a persistent pi-ai `CredentialStore` with serialized read-"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"modify-write (`dsh-atomic-write`).
- `src/auth.ts` — login/status/logout over pi-ai's `openai-codex`"},{"id":"p25s3","text":" OAuth provider.
- `src/adapter.ts` — `CodexAdapter extends LlmAdapter` (from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"), registered with `ctx.llm.registerAdapter(['codex'], …)`; `stream()` resolves/refreshes auth throu"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"gh pi-ai, enforces provider-idle timeout, and aborts SDK work when its consumer stops.
- `src/conver"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"t.ts` — request/stream vocabulary conversion, adapted from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` (MIT, © Deep"},{"id":"p25s7","text":"Seek AI) with image attachment support and provider-native replay state omitted.
- `src/index.ts` — "},{"id":"p25s8","text":"the Cordis function plugin (`name`/`inject`/`Config`/`apply`); registers the adapter and, when the c"},{"id":"p25s9","text":"omposition mounts `ctx.commands`, the `/codex` command."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Limitations"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- **Text only.** Model metadata advertises only text input, and image content is refused with `UNSUP"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"PORTED_CONTENT` before any provider request.
- **No browser Models-page card.** Configuration happen"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"s through the patch layer and the picker lists the route through the adapter registry; login is the "},{"id":"p27s4","text":"bin or `/codex` command, not the credentials page.
- **No provider-native replay state.** Historical"},{"id":"p27s5","text":" assistant messages replay as provider-neutral content (correct, but without signature/cache reuse)."},{"id":"p27s6","text":"
- **Browser login assumes a desktop browser.** Machines without one run `dsh-codex-oauth login --me"},{"id":"p27s7","text":"thod device` in a terminal.
- **One browser login at a time.** The OAuth callback uses one local por"},{"id":"p27s8","text":"t; wait for one browser flow to finish before starting another.
